transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here today because I've been feeling extremely down and sad for the past two months. I've also completely lost interest in any of my usual hobbies or activities. It just feels like I can't pull myself out of this dark cloud.
Have you ever had periods in your life lasting a few days or more where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, 'high', or hyperactive, needing very little sleep?

Yes, absolutely. Before this crash, I had a period of about nine months where I felt incredibly 'high', bursting with energy, and was constantly on the go. It was the complete opposite of how I feel now, like I was operating at 200%.
During those high periods or even when you felt down, did you ever experience things like hearing voices, seeing things others couldn't, or holding beliefs that other people found highly unusual?

No, I've never heard voices or seen things that weren't there. However, during my high periods, I did hold very strong beliefs that others found unusual, like feeling like I was an incredibly special person with a grand, unique mission.
Did you ever experience these unusual beliefs during times when your mood was completely normal and stable, or did they only happen when you were feeling very high or down?
No, those beliefs only happened when I was feeling extremely high and full of energy. I never had those thoughts when my mood was normal, nor have I felt that way during this recent down period.
